Hi Katie —

Thanks for the asks, noted below:
- Redaction: we'll add a redaction flag column in the spreadsheet and include an MD5 manifest for each redacted file. Rishi will own the redaction pass.
- SOC 2 mapping: I attached a short mapping doc inside the evidence folder ("SOC2_SIG_mapping.txt"), and we will also add a column to the SIG spreadsheet that references SOC control IDs.
- Box zip: yes, we can package the folder as a single encrypted zip for archival. Estimated uncompressed size after redaction: ~120 MB. We will provide checksum and a signed transfer manifest.

Next steps for the 11/12 checkpoint:
1) We upload the worked spreadsheet + evidence index by 11/11 EOD PT.
2) Rishi completes redaction and populates the redaction manifest by 11/15.
3) We prepare the boxed zip and provide checksum by 11/17 so procurement can archive before 11/19.

If procurement needs the zip earlier, let us know and we'll accelerate.

Best,
